title: Lighting · Soft shadows and sky reflections
description: Each view after (shadows fitted to the view: PCSS on WebGPU, PCF 5×5 on WebGL2; sky reflections) and before (the old PCF 3×3 over the whole view box, no sky); the street's close crop also shows VSM and PCF 5×5 with the fit. Run with --gpu (WebGPU) and --gpu --webgl. Toggles: window.gerard.game.lighting (shadows, fit, sky).

steps.eval: window.look = mode => { const l = window.gerard.game.lighting; const own = l.settings.shadow.type[window.gerard.game.app.graphicsDevice.isWebGPU ? 'webgpu' : 'webgl2']; const m = { after: [own, true, true], before: ['pcf3', false, false], vsm: ['vsm', true, true], pcf: ['pcf5', true, true] }[mode]; l.shadows = m[0]; l.fit = m[1]; l.sky = m[2]; }
